titleRotation.comment: Default: every Monday at 6am. Titles now come from the Titles table in Airtable, sorted by the Order field.

dailyActivity.comment: Default: every day at 9am. Prompts now come from the ActivityPrompts table in Airtable (Prompt + optional Image), sorted by the Order field.

birthdays.comment: Default: checked every day at 7am. The list now comes from the Birthdays table in Airtable (Name, Phone, Month, Day, optional Photo).
